Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning for hire vehicles, limousines, and taxicabs.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to for hire vehicles, limousines, and taxicabs; amending RCW 51.12.183; and creating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 51.12.183 and 2011 c 190 s 2 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) On or after January 1, 2012, any business that owns andoperates a for hire vehicle licensed under chapter 46.72 RCW, alimousine under chapter 46.72A RCW, or a taxicab under chapter 81.72RCW and the for hire operator or chauffeur of such vehicle is withinthe mandatory coverage of this title. (2) On or after January 1, 2012, any business that as owner oragent leases a for hire vehicle licensed under chapter 46.72 RCW, alimousine under chapter 46.72A RCW, or a taxicab under chapter 81.72RCW to a for hire operator or a chauffeur and the for hire operator orchauffeur of such vehicle is within the mandatory coverage of thistitle. (3) For the purposes of this section, a business that hascontracted for the services of a business that owned and operated, oras owner or agent leased, a for hire vehicle licensed under chapter p. 1 SB 581446.72 RCW, a limousine under chapter 46.72A RCW, or a taxicab underchapter 81.72 RCW is not within the mandatory coverage of this title,and is not responsible primarily or indirectly for premiums upon thework. (4) Prior to January 1, 2012, any business that owned and operated,or as owner or agent leased, a for hire vehicle licensed under chapter46.72 RCW, a limousine under chapter 46.72A RCW, or a taxicab underchapter 81.72 RCW, and the for hire operator or chauffeur of suchvehicle is presumed not to have been within the mandatory coverage ofthis title. However, a claim is presumed to have been within themandatory coverage of this title and may be used to rebut thepresumption of this subsection (4) if the claim: (a) Is for a medical or time loss payment by or on behalf of a forhire operator or chauffeur; (b) Is a result of work performed and injury suffered prior toJanuary 1, 2012, with or through any business that owned and operated,or as owner or agent leased: (i) A for hire vehicle licensed under chapter 46.72 RCW; (ii) A limousine under chapter 46.72A RCW; or (iii) A taxicab under chapter 81.72 RCW. (5) Any business that owned and operated, or as owner or agentleased, or contracted for the services of, a for hire vehicle licensedunder chapter 46.72 RCW, a limousine under chapter 46.72A RCW, or ataxicab under chapter 81.72 RCW that paid premium, penalty, or interestto the department in settlement of a claim for unpaid premiums by thedepartment prior to January 1, 2012, where no fault for such premiumclaim was admitted, must have such payment refunded by the departmentwithin ninety days after the effective date of this section. (6) Any payment made pursuant to subsection (5) of this sectionmust be reduced by the amount of any expenditure made by the departmentfor or on behalf of any for hire operator or chauffeur contracted oraffiliated with the business, as a result of a medical or time lossclaim, and which originates in or is otherwise attributable to theperiod for which the premium claim is assessed on the business by thedepartment. (7) For the purposes of this section, the following definitionsapply unless the context clearly requires otherwise: SB 5814 p. 2 (a) "Chauffeur" has the same meaning as provided in RCW 46.04.115;and (b) "For hire operator" means a person who is operating a vehiclefor the purpose of carrying persons for compensation.
This act applies both prospectively andretroactively to all causes of action arising under this section.
